sources.title: Feeds
sources.description: DexScreener feeds to pull: top_boosted (most boosted now), latest_boosted (just boosted), latest_profiles (new tokens that just added a profile), takeovers (community takeovers).

searchQueries.title: Search
searchQueries.description: Token name, symbol or address to search, e.g. PEPE, BONK, AI agent. Up to 20.

tokenAddresses.title: Token addresses
tokenAddresses.description: Your tokens as chain:address, e.g. solana:DezXAZ8z7PnrnRJjz3wXBoRgixCa6xjnB7YaB1pPB263 or ethereum:0x6982508145454ce325ddbe47a25d4ec3d2311933. Up to 500.

chains.title: Chains
chains.description: Keep only these chains, e.g. solana, ethereum, base, bsc, arbitrum, sui, ton. Empty = all chains.

minLiquidityUsd.title: Min liquidity (USD)
minLiquidityUsd.description: Skip tokens whose deepest pair has less liquidity.

minMarketCapUsd.title: Min market cap (USD)
minMarketCapUsd.description: 0 = no minimum. Uses FDV when market cap is missing.

maxPairAgeHours.title: Max pair age (hours)
maxPairAgeHours.description: Only tokens whose deepest pair was created in the last N hours (fresh launches). 0 = any age.

maxRows.title: Max tokens
maxRows.description: Cap on rows returned (highest 24h volume first). Controls cost.
